visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a bright medium shot of two sleek kitchen appliances—a white and a beige VOTO steam oven—positioned on a clean white countertop. In the background, two vases of purple and white flowers add a soft decorative touch. Yellow and white text overlays appear in the center of the frame. (2) The camera cuts to a tight close-up of the interior of the white oven, revealing significant grease buildup, brown stains, and food residue on the stainless steel floor and back walls. (3) A woman in a black-and-white striped shirt is shown in a medium shot; she holds a white square container and pours a white powdery substance (baking soda) into a matching white ceramic bowl. (4) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a kitchen sink where the woman places the bowl under a faucet, adding a small amount of water to the powder. (5) The woman's hand, with manicured nails, is seen in a close-up as she places the bowl of solution into the oven and presses the digital 'Steam Clean' button on the touch-sensitive control panel. (6) A montage follows, showing the digital timer counting down from 50 minutes and steam visibly filling the glass door of the oven. (7) She opens the door, and a cloud of steam escapes; she uses a heat-resistant glove to remove the bowl and then uses a white checkered cloth to wipe the bottom tray, showing the grease coming off easily. (8) In a subsequent phase, she adds clear dish soap to a bowl and uses a yellow-and-green sponge to scrub more persistent stains on the side tracks and the top heating elements. (9) A split-screen comparison is displayed, clearly labeling 'Before' and 'After' to show the transformation from a stained interior to a pristine, reflective stainless steel surface. (10) The video concludes with the woman gesturing towards the now sparkling clean oven as it sits next to its beige counterpart, signaling the successful completion of the task.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 蒸汽烤箱 快速又簡單的清潔模式. [Logo]: VOTO. (2) [Subtitle]: 大家使用這種蒸氣氣炸烤箱 最怕的就是它的清潔很麻煩 而且又常常清不乾淨呢. (3) [Subtitle]: 所以這次呢 我特別留了一堆污垢 想要示範範給大家看 我最近發現又快 又方便的清潔模式. (4) [Subtitle]: 大家可以找家裡都有的小蘇打粉 加一點進去 隨便亂調 再加一點水. (5) [Subtitle]: 調和之後呢 就直接放進我們的蒸氣烤箱. (6) [Subtitle]: 利用機器本身自帶的 清潔模式跑一圈. (7) [Subtitle]: 清潔模式整個跑完要50分鐘 但是我通常不會 讓他一次跑完 大概30分鐘左右 我就 停止. (8) [Subtitle]: 趁它有點溫度的時候再擦 那 這個是拋棄式抹布. (9) [Subtitle]: 這個污垢 我們 反覆的擦 它就會掉下來了 包括這一條一條的縫. (10) [Subtitle]: 你也可以擠一點洗碗精在裡面 拿一個海綿 沾這洗 然後再刷. (11) [Subtitle]: 力道稍微抓一下 不要太過於用力 這輕輕刷就刷起來了 平常就是稍微擦一下就好了. (12) [Subtitle]: 烘乾模式 這邊有一個乾燥模式. (13) [Subtitle]: 清潔前後對比. (14) [Subtitle]: 大家看一下清潔後的效果. (15) [Subtitle]: 更髒的話可以再跑一次清潔模式 這樣子差不多就完成啦. (16) [Subtitle]: 是這一台的大清潔分享給大家.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a friendly and clear female narrator speaking in Traditional Chinese, accompanied by an upbeat, mid-tempo major-key pop BGM featuring bright piano and synth textures. (2) A subtle plastic 'click' and the sound of powder pouring into a bowl are heard as the narrator explains the preparation of the cleaning solution. (3) The sound of running water from a tap creates a brief ambient shift as the narrator mentions mixing. (4) Distinct mechanical 'clicks' and UI beeps occur as the narrator describes interacting with the appliance's touch control panel to start the steam mode. (5) A low, steady mechanical hum representing the oven's fan becomes faintly audible during the steaming phase, while the narration continues consistently. (6) A sharp latch 'click' signifies the opening of the oven door, followed by the soft rustling of a cloth wiping a metallic surface. (7) The percussive 'pump' of a soap dispenser and the squelching sound of a wet sponge are heard as she transitions to deep cleaning. (8) The video ends with the narrator's tone becoming celebratory and encouraging, concluding with a light 'whoosh' transition and the music fading out at a natural pace.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate owners of steam air fryer ovens on an easy and efficient cleaning method using baking soda and the appliance's built-in steam function. It effectively showcases the VOTO brand's product features through a practical, high-appeal 'before and after' demonstration.
